title: Tree conversion preserves the accepted language
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean directed acyclic circuits such that, in every circuit, each gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. The language accepted by the tree family obtained by unfolding these circuits equals the language accepted by $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate in every circuit has pairwise distinct arguments
Every NOT gate in every circuit has exactly one argument
